name: מִבְחָר
summary: One of David's mighty men, “Mibhar son of Hagri”, named only in the Chronicles list (1Ch 11:38). The name is the noun מִבְחָר “the choicest” (Gen 23:6; Ezk 24:5). The parallel list in 2Sa 23:36 has at this place “Igal son of Nathan of Zobah (מִצֹּבָה), Bani the Gadite”, so the two lists differ here and the text does not settle whether the two names are the same man.

evidence.note: “Joel the brother of Nathan, מִבְחָר son of Hagri.”
The parallel: “Igal son of Nathan מִצֹּבָה, Bani the Gadite.”
“In the מִבְחַר of our tombs”: the noun the name is.

note: Takes b.bg.ai (1 token). The two lists of the mighty men (2Sa 23:24–39; 1Ch 11:26–47) differ at this point: מִבְחָר בֶּן־הַגְרִי against מִצֹּבָה בָּנִי הַגָּדִי, which share several letters; whether one reading arose from the other is a question of the text, not decided here. TIPNR records Mibhar as a person.
